footnote_text: Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated September 29, 2025, by and among Clywedog Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. (formerly known as Beacon Topco, Inc.) (the "Issuer"), Barinthus Biotherapeutics plc, Cdog Merger Sub, Inc. and Clywedog Therapeutics, Inc. ("Clywedog") (as amended, the "Merger Agreement"), each share of common stock and each share of series seed preferred stock of Clywedog beneficially owned by each Reporting Person at the effective time of the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement was exchanged for (i) 0.741416 shares of common stock of the Issuer and (ii) an amount in cash for which any fractional shares of the Issuer to which the Reporting Person would be entitled sold on the open market. || These securities are directly held by TPAV, LLC ("TPAV"). || Mr. Savchuk is the sole manager on the Board of Managers of TPAV and also owns a 31% interest in TPAV. This report is jointly filed by TPAV and Mr. Savchuk. Each of the Reporting Persons disclaims beneficial ownership of the securities reported herein for purposes of Rule 16a-1(a) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1943, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), except to the extent of its pecuniary interest therein, if any. This report shall not be deemed an admission that any of the Reporting Persons is a beneficial owner of such securities for purposes of Section 16 of the Exchange Act, or for any other purpose.
